profile.summary: Balaxi Pharmaceuticals Limited engages in the international wholesale distribution of pharmaceuticals, builders hardware, and FMCG products in India, Africa, and Latin America. The company offers pharmaceutical products across various therapeutic areas, including antibiotics, analgesic, anti-malaria, and others. It also provides biscuits and toothpaste. The company was formerly known as Balaxi Ven
